hypotheses.APCTT-C01: The report states the scientific or engineering principles on which the technology is based.
hypotheses.APCTT-C02: The report describes a practical application of the technology and how it is intended to work.
hypotheses.APCTT-C03: The report presents analytical or laboratory results that demonstrate the critical function of the technology.
hypotheses.APCTT-C04: The component or breadboard was tested in a laboratory environment and the results are reported.
hypotheses.APCTT-C05: The component or breadboard was tested in a simulated or relevant environment and the results are reported.
hypotheses.APCTT-C06: A representative prototype of the system was demonstrated in a relevant environment.
hypotheses.APCTT-C07: A prototype close to the final configuration was demonstrated in the actual operational environment.
hypotheses.APCTT-C08: The final system was completed and qualified through test and demonstration against its requirements.
hypotheses.APCTT-C09: The final system was used successfully in actual operations over a stated period.
hypotheses.APCTT-C10: Measured performance was compared with stated requirements or acceptance criteria, and it is stated whether they were met.
hypotheses.APCTT-C11: The test conditions and the configuration of the tested article are described.
hypotheses.APCTT-C12: The tested evidence concerns the assessed technology itself.
